experiment.title: Pressure, commitment, escape
experiment.hypothesis: More deliberate movement may make pressure and commitment easier to anticipate while preserving satisfying bursts. None of these approaches working is a useful result.

variants.name: Measured commitments
variants.description: Slower travel; stop to charge. Does a clearer commitment create anticipation or make the duel static?

variants.name: Bursts and resets
variants.description: Slower neutral travel, faster sprints and dashes, planted recovery. Does contrast create momentum or more circling?

evidenceLimits: Screening evidence; no owner preference or balance validation yet.
Damage gaps are descriptive, not a score for entertainment or tension.
Rotations test layout sensitivity, not swapping asymmetric fighter kits.
Current telemetry has spell-type IDs, not unique cast/projectile causal IDs. Do not attribute a dodge to a specific incoming attack.
Raw rejected-cast diagnostics are retained in JSONL and omitted from the curated event excerpts.
